# LearnMYOG

LearnMYOG (learnmyog.com) is a free resource for DIY outdoor gear makers. It publishes sewing patterns and step-by-step tutorials for making your own ultralight backpacks, technical apparel, rainwear, and adventure gear, plus guidance on fabrics, zippers, hardware, and construction techniques.

## Key pages
- / — Home: pattern library and featured makes
- /about.html — About LearnMYOG
- /zerotohero.html — Beginner's guide to making your own outdoor gear
- /fabrics.html — Technical fabrics for packs, pockets & linings
- /hardware.html — Hardware picker
- /map.html — Site map
- /gallery.html — Maker gallery
